title: "mix_audio" function in AudioStreamPlayback has non deterministic behaviour, often causing the project to crash entirely
body:
### Tested versions

v4.4.dev4.mono.official [36e6207bb]

### System information

Godot v4.4.dev4.mono - Fedora Linux 40.20240615.0 (Kinoite) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 Ti (nvidia; 550.90.07) - AMD Ryzen 5 2600X Six-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

When using the new `MixAudio` method provided in the latest dev release for the AudioStreamPlayback class ( in c#, where i tested it) any combination of numeric  values on the larger side ( ie it seems to occur when the amount of rate_scale * frames passes roughly 100k ish ( i assume this might be moreso related to the amount of seconds of audio being skipped ? ))  will make the project extremely crash prone, and inconsistenly so. 

To make matters worse when it fails it completely silently and on occasion fails in different ways ( sometimes ive had only the audio stop, but the program continue running, sometimes it manages to output the print statements i put in to check the time elapsed, etc)

Ontop of that even when smaller values are used in the method, repeated use ( as i do with a series of timers in the MRP) eventually seems to cause the program to crash regardless)

it hasnt happened since i switch the audio file type to mp3 from ogg vorbis but with a vorbis file it will occasionally cause an "Error during vorbis synthesis" error"

_Im entirely open to the possibility that this is considered out of scope usage of the method ( since the chunks i was planning to grab are rather large, for the purpose of displaying a waveform)._


**In terms of what id expect:**

- A failure of the method to return what is asked of it to not crash the project.

- The method to throw a proper error upon misuse at the very least  if it does cause a critical failure ( for example in the form of an error message with the maximum recommended range of values to be used with it)




### Steps to reproduce

Anything i can think to say here would  be more clearly illustrated by checking the only code file in the MRP. 

I shall attach however a video of the issue for people not interested in having to download the project:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2184c113-36ac-4023-a22b-1aa69280c04c



### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[waveform-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17705517/waveform-test.zip)
